author: jordanbr937
quote:
This IS NOT GTA. This is a romantic movie calling itself GTA. There are areas where npcs are protected classes, and you dont have freedom anymore. You follow an Ubisoft style script. You do what they allow you to do within the context they want you in. No player choice has any impact, the main characters are dull lifeless and predictable, no stand out scenes or memorable moments, this is a sad day for the gaming community worldwide. We now know ALL the journalists and publications are payed off or bullied into giving this game a 10. Just look at the user scores now. From those of us who gain nothing from giving a review. We are letdown and disappointed in whatever Rockstar is today. 

This isn't Grand Theft Auto. This is basically Watchdogs with a romantic storyline. It ****.
